sections.heading: C2 — Traffic signs and work zones
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Traffic signs and work zones

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A50
A School Zone sign warns of a nearby school crossing where drivers should watch for children. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A50
Violating a school-zone speed limit carries increased penalties. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A50
A School Zone sign may be yellow or fluorescent yellow-green. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A50
An Added Lane sign describes highways converging and warns that traffic from the left lane may move into the right lane. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A50
When moving left near an added-lane area, first check that the lane is clear and signal the lane change. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A50
A Two-Way Traffic sign warns that a divided multilane highway changes to a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A50
On the main road, a Merging Traffic sign warns that other vehicles may enter the driver's lane. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A50
A Lane Ends or Merge Left sign warns that two lanes become one and that merging traffic must yield. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A51
A Low Clearance sign warns of very low overhead clearance above the highway. [A51]
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A51
A Divided Highway Ends sign warns that opposing traffic will no longer be separated by a center strip. [A51]
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A51
At a School Crossing warning, watch for children, slow down and obey the crossing guard. [A51]
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A51
A School Crossing sign may be yellow or fluorescent yellow-green. [A51]
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec05-R13 | anchor: A51
A Pedestrian Crossing sign warns of crossing pedestrians who have the right of way and may require the driver to stop. [A51]
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec05-R14 | anchor: A51
A Pedestrian Crossing sign may be fluorescent yellow-green and may use flashing lights to show that a pedestrian is crossing. [A51]
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec05-R15 | anchor: A51
A Divided Highway Begins sign warns that a center strip will separate the two directions of traffic ahead. [A51]
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec05-R16 | anchor: A52
A Share the Road sign below a bicycle symbol warns drivers and bicyclists to share a highway where bicycle lanes are absent. [A52]
Source: [A52 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec05-R17 | anchor: A52
Share the Road signs may be placed where lanes or shoulders are narrow or traffic volume or speed is high. [A52]
Source: [A52 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec05-R18 | anchor: A52
The pennant-shaped No Passing Zone sign stands on the left side and warns that passing is prohibited for that lane. [A52]
Source: [A52 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec05-R19 | anchor: A52
A downhill warning directs drivers to check their brakes before descending the steep hill ahead. [A52]
Source: [A52 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec05-R20 | anchor: A52
A Slippery When Wet sign warns that wet weather may make the road slippery and calls for slowing under those conditions. [A52]
Source: [A52 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec05-R21 | anchor: A52
A railroad advance warning calls for readiness to stop before the tracks if a train approaches the crossing. [A52]
Source: [A52 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec05-R22 | anchor: A53
An Animal Crossing warning calls for watching for animals crossing the highway. [A53]
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec05-R23 | anchor: A53
A railroad Emergency Notification System sign is posted at or near a crossing and provides the railroad phone number and that crossing's identifying number. [A53]
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec05-R24 | anchor: A53
The railroad emergency sign supplies the information needed to report an emergency or a warning-device malfunction to the railroad. [A53]
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec05-R25 | anchor: A53
White-on-green guide signs provide direction and distance information. [A53]
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec05-R26 | anchor: A53
White-on-blue guide signs identify motorist services. [A53]
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec05-R27 | anchor: A53
White-on-brown guide signs identify cultural, historical or scenic points of interest. [A53]
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec05-R28 | anchor: A54
Barricades may carry flashing lights, especially at night. [A54]
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec05-R29 | anchor: A54
The handbook describes permanent barricades as red and white and temporary barricades as orange and white. [A54]
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec05-R30 | anchor: A54
Different barricade colors do not change the directions their patterns give drivers. [A54]
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec05-R31 | anchor: A54
A V-shaped barricade pattern means the road is closed and traffic cannot proceed farther. [A54]
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec05-R32 | anchor: A54
Barricade stripes slanting down toward the left direct traffic past the barricade on its left side. [A54]
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec05-R33 | anchor: A54
Barricade stripes slanting down toward the right direct traffic past the barricade on its right side. [A54]
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0054]
